notes.title: WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale 🐬
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35919058/450d62f4a5ffd4c9e04bc375696cdc41d06ea966.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that we're supporting [b]WDC: Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day! 🐬[/b]

The [b]WDC World Ocean Day Sale[/b] starts today and runs until 15th June, 10am PDT 2024, and you can save a fin-tastic:
[list]
[*] 25% off in [b]Chessarama[/b]
[*] 50% off in [b]Daylife in Japan, Chess Knights: Shinobi, Colorgrid, & Knight Swap[/b]
[/list]
We will also donate 5% and 50% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RAYiDEw.jpeg[/img]
[i]Photo: Mignon[/i]

[h2]Who is WDC?[/h2]

[b]WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/b] is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins.

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.

Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic creatures.

Entanglement in fishing gear, or ‘bycatch’ as it’s known, is the biggest threat whales and dolphins face. Many hundreds of thousands die in nets or get tangled up in fishing gear every year. As air-breathing mammals like us, when they get trapped in a net, panic can take over and they can sustain terrible injuries before either escaping, or suffocating. It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.

[h2]What WDC has been doing so far [/h2]

WDC have been working across the globe to protect whales, dolphins and porpoises from dying in fishing gear: 
[list]
[*] They’re collaborating with creel fishers in Scotland to trial new types of fishing gear to reduce entanglements of humpback and minke whales. 
[*] They’re working with colleagues and partner organisations in the Central Baltic Sea to develop a recovery plan for a critically endangered group of Baltic harbour porpoises. 
[*] On the west coast of the United States, critically endangered North Atlantic right whales are facing extinction. Entanglement is a massive threat to their survival, and WDC have been working with fishers to trial alternative gear types. 
[*] In Hong Kong WDC have been supporting local community efforts and working with fishers to save the remaining 200 Indo-Pacific finless porpoises from extinction due to bycatch.   
[/list]
These projects are saving lives, and they are powered by inspiring people working together for the ocean.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/85wkNLY.jpeg[/img]
[i]Photo: Shutterstock[/i]

[h2]How your support will help this year[/h2]

By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue these vital conservation projects across the globe, as well as enable WDC’s team to embark on new efforts to bring further protections for whales and dolphins, like the Sri Lankan gillnet fisheries project: 
[list]
[*] Sri Lanka is home to many species of whales, dolphins and porpoises as well as a myriad of other sensitive marine species like sea turtles that are vulnerable to entanglement in gillnets – these are nets that hang in the water like a wall. With funding, WDC hopes to collaborate with Sri Lankan artisanal tuna fisheries that use gillnets to trial new gear types and reduce the impact their fishing has on marine life, while still enabling them to earn their living.[/list]
Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused. 

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here:
[url=https://whales.org/ ]https://whales.org/ [/url]
Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does here:
[url=https://games.whales.org/ ]https://games.whales.org/ [/url]
And you can find many other amazing games in the sale here:
[url=https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale24]https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale24[/url]

Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! 💙

[i]*5% and 50% of our net revenue from this sale will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831830/Chessarama/

notes.title: Chessarama page is live! Wishlist it now.
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/72ffb433f24126c58bea016eed1061e88b26d574.png[/img]

We have a big announcement today!

🥳  The Steam Page for Chessarama is finally LIVE! 🥳 

You can WISHLIST it now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831830/Chessarama/

Wishlisting a game is reeeeaallly helpful, so please don't forget to wishlist and follow Chessarama on Steam!

We are working hard on this game and veeery excited to launch it next year!


[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/05d652eab7386395340d62acd4063f328d203344.png[/img]

Chessarama is a collection of original chess-inspired turn-based games. Choose a game, quickly learn its rules and play through the campaigns, community levels or build your own puzzles.

Chessarama features several full games, each one of them with its own set of rules, art, pieces and game mechanics. 

Each game will feature a Creative Mode that will allow you to create your own puzzles and challenge other players to beat it. 

In the Community Hub, you will be able to play hundreds (thousands?!) of levels created by other players. Endless replayability and fun awaits for you.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/9ee4de8c4cf618f2804b704ced0dd1a56208015b.png[/img]

Chessarama reimagine chess rules and mechanics using many different themes. Each game has its own theme, set of rules and original handcrafted levels for you to play!

Want a sneak peak on some of those games? Awesome! Here you go:

[b]What if... chess pieces were high-fantasy heroes fighting a mighty Dragon?
[/b]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/3b4704b0fed82c4725f63f0207d3be09b3c84a2e.gif[/img]

In Dragon Slayer, you need to push your pawn to the end of a path in order to kill the mighty dragon. But it will not be that easy! The dragon attacks the board every time the pawn moves and every undefended piece will die. So you need the help of your friends (Rooks, Bishops and Knights) to protect your pawn all along the way to the dragon's core. This is a strategic game for chess enthusiasts of all levels. Sacrifices will be necessary along the way, so be ready!

[b]What if... chess pieces were samurais fighting a legendary Ronin in feudal Japan?
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/9e0d9b768db442050e11718fa74e59dae08f6465.gif[/img]
In Ronin Highlander, chess meets sokoban as you have never seen before. You play with a legendary Ronin (a chess queen) and you need to push away the other pieces in order to get close to the Shogun and kill it. Pieces move like in chess, but push each other like in sokoban. Can you pass through legions of samurais to achieve your goal?

[b]What if... the chess board were a soccer stadium and chess pieces strive not for checkmate, but for striking goals?
[/b]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/4391bf625b9cdcd6d2d6b1d625d931739aaf34e0.gif[/img]

In Soccer Chess you will play a soccer match using chess pieces and tactics! As in chess (or soccer!) you will need to think 2-3 moves ahead if you want to break through the adversary's defenses and strike a beautiful goal!

[b]What if chess could be reinvented over and over again? 
[/b]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/5c91ebbed7c13744078b5fd2679ccf06666e06a4.gif[/img]

Well, it can. It will. 
This is just the beginning.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/020cd5ac056a02646dc238d88576eff51df13189.png[/img]

[b]What Chessarama offers
[/b]
[list]
[*] Play all original and exclusive chess-inspired games available in Chessarama;
[*] Learn and practice many chess skills: strategic thinking, tactics, visualization, grid geometry and much more;
[*] Create your own puzzles and challenge other players to solve it;
[*] Unique art style, with beautiful dioramas;
[*] High replay value - An always growing library of community levels for you to play.
[*] Learn chess movements, tactics and strategies through a modern videogame experience.
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/98f8757269d23d26646ff3adbbe212453dd42891.png[/img]

Chessarama is being developed by a small studio from Brazil. We are passionate about creating smart puzzles, beautiful dioramas and high-quality games.

Together we want to help chess becoming even more popular, by providing to all kind of players a modern videogame experience with solid chess inspirations.

Oh, you've read until the end, huh?! Nice! So what to do next? First, hit the Wishlist Chessarama to follow this game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831830/Chessarama/

And don't forget to join our Discord server to be up to date with the development, meet the developers and have early access to screenshots, videos and demos!

[url=https://discord.gg/ysYuUhcx7k][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/6e0e5e1f54800cd1c9e88d23a575fac479502217.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Hey! We Have Something Free and Special Just for You!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/4af2fc347f845b15f8c987ed68d8a7cba7245588.png[/img]

Helloooo everyone!

My name is Raphael and I am creative director at Minimol Games. We are a small indie game studio from Brazil working on puzzle games inspired by Chess tactics and strategies.

Maybe you know some of our titles like Zen Chess, Unlock The King or Knights Retreat.

The image above is from the game we are working on right now (to be released in 2022). It is a premium collection of tabletop games inspired by Chess culture, tactics and strategies. It will feature many different (original) games (all in one), hundreds of puzzles, a Creative Mode (for you to design your own puzzles), and some of the cutest Chess Pieces you’ve ever seen :)

Its development has been a lot of fun and we finally got to the point where we feel confortable in sharing its first demo for a small group (for free!)

This demo alone could be a complete $3-$5 dollars game on Steam, so we hope you have a lot of fun with it! Just keep in mind that it is a alpha version of it, and it can have a lot of bugs or strange things happening. You will be able to report those in-game , as well as give us suggestions and feedbacks!

If you would like to help us (and have some fun playing it!), please click the link bellow to enter our discord server! We will release this first demovery soon and EXCLUSIVELY through our Discord server, so that we can manage it properly and give you the right support.

Here is the link (it will expire soon): https://discord.gg/ysYuUhcx7k

Hope to see you inside! Cheers!

Knight's Retreat is now available! (FULL RELEASE)
The Chess Variants Club
notes.content:
Hi!

Nice to see you here.

My name is Raphael and I am the Creative Director at Minimol Games. For a long time I've been trying to create "game-like chess experiences" I'd love to play.

All started with the Zen Chess Series, then Knight Swap, Hang The Kings, Unlock The King... and, most recently, Knight's Retreat.

Now is time to bring to reality our biggest project to date: The Chess Variants Club.

I am a great enthusiast of minimalist design, and I am very happy with the ambience we are creating to this game.

And as a chess player I am very happy to create a game mostly (but not solely) based on famous Chess Variants.

There are several incredibly interesting chess variants I believe everyone should play at least once!

And if it is worthy playing, it is certainly worthy playing in a minimalist, beautifully designed chess board. That is exactly what we are aiming for in this game.

You can wishlist it right here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292240/The_Chess_Variants_Club/

Kind regards,
Raphael
